author: ImRaging
body:
This is a thread where i'm planning to get discussions going about what you guys think about certain topics. I may or may not update this (if i remember to or get ideas, sure) so stay tuned!

I'm welcome to ideas about what should be discussed, just be nice and calm. If any arguments spark then they'll be dealt with and remember that this is for feedback, not a rant thread to/about other people, whether staff or non-staff.

If you have ideas about what to discuss, then simply put it down below!

The first topic is: Swearing. Should it be allowed or disallowed?

Ask away Avicus :)

Topics to come:

1)Prestiges
2)Donor Perks

replies.author: Sevoo
replies.body:
You should be allowed to swear. Swear words are only words. If they are there, why not use them? You should be able to use swear words as long as you don't direct to anyone. 

Allowed: ex. Fuck me! Lets say you're falling in the void. Say this, no harm done.

Not allowed: ex. Fuck you! Lets say someone killed you. Say this, and harm IS done. You are being offensive to someone.

Now don't come saying that 9 year old kids can see these words and use them in real life or something, because, lets cut straight to the chase, those kids already know these words. Some people just don't want to believe it, but the world has come to a point where it's impossible to stay away from these words. Everyone that knows English has heard these words, and they may not use them, but some of us do. Don't go around blaming my kind of people that I'm ruining our youth or some shit like that, because it was already ruined.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
I preferred the swearing rule that Tyler and Peachy put into place...

You could say: shit, crap and fuck. However, there were 'limitations'.
  • No directed comments. eg. 'Your shit at pvp!'
  • Not to be used excessively. eg. 'Shit' (30 seconds later) 'Crap' etc.
You may be thinking why fuck was allowed, but it was reasoned with common sense, ok so imagine you're running home with the wool on a one-block wide bridge yeah? And someone mlg snipes you off, you're going to be pissed aren't you? It's human nature, so it's common sense to allow people to drop the F-bomb if they get killed like that. Bearing that in mind, any thing more like 'FUCK' or 'fuck you' would be punishable.

Since my removal from the staff team I don't know what new 'guidelines' were put in place, but I always trained Junior Mods with that rule.
